name: Ordering platform management
pick: Pick on which aggregators the merchant uses, single vs multi-brand, and country.

name: Loyalty & CRM
pick: Pick on how deep the merchant goes: quick wallet cards, loyalty plus feedback and ordering, or a full CRM with campaigns.

name: Online ordering & web store
pick: Pick on country first. Prices exist only in some currencies, so check that before anything else.

name: Inventory
pick: Pick on budget and depth: ShopBrain is tiered per branch, Supy is premium per outlet with a 3-license minimum.

name: Accounting
pick: Pick on branch count and whether the merchant needs setup help.

name: ERP
pick: Pick on size: FlowERP for KSA small and mid-size, SAP or Dynamics for enterprise groups.

name: E-invoicing & digital receipts
pick: Both are licensed per account, not per branch. Pick on terminals and SMS vs invoice volume.

name: HR & payroll
pick: Both sit on top of SAP. Malachite cannot be sold without SAP.

name: Other
pick: Niche or inactive. Confirm with Partnerships before quoting.
